description: This file defines the CompositeDisplayField entity class, which extends AbstractDisplayField. It represents a composite display field in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for its ID and associated selected composite display fields. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: CompositeDisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing a composite display field with ORM mappings, ID, and a collection of associated selected composite display fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the composite display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the composite display field.
